name: Jochen Krauss
headline: Senior Advisor & Interim Executive | Helping organizations turn complexity into decisions & action
summary:
I work with organizations and leadership teams in situations of high complexity — when direction is unclear, decisions are delayed, or strategy needs to be translated into action.

My strength lies in structuring complex situations quickly, clarifying decision options, and helping organizations regain decisional and operational momentum.

I have spent most of my career in international environments, working across Europe and Asia in senior advisory and leadership roles. After more than a decade as a partner in a global strategy consultancy, I deliberately stepped into an independent role to focus on selected advisory and interim engagements where clarity, trust, and execution matter most.

Depending on the situation, I support as a senior advisor and sparring partner — or take on clearly defined interim responsibility during transition and transformation phases.

I am based in Malta and work internationally, primarily in English and German.
